senses.gloss: measure of capacity; trnsf. (v. מִדָּה) retribution, dealing out.
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 23:29">Targ. I Chr. XXIII, 29</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:22">Targ. Job IX, 22</cite> <he>חדא מ׳</he> the same destiny.—Pl. <cite ref="M01379"><he>מְכִילָן</he></cite>, <he>מְכִלָן</he>, <cite ref="M01379"><he>מְכִילָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01379"><he>מְכִלָ׳</he></cite>. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 19:36">Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 36</cite> (Y. <he>מְכִילוּ</he>, read: … <he>לָן</he>). Y. B. Bath. V, end, 15ᵇ <he>הוה מחי על מ׳</he> punished for false measures.

senses.gloss: a vessel used in connection with the show-bread in the Temple.—Pl. מְכִילָתָא.

senses.gloss: (cmp. מִדָּה) a collection of rules of interpretation, treatise, tract.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 44a:10">Gitt. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>עיין במְכִילְתֵּיךְ</he> read it up in thy collection (Boraitha).
<cite ref="Pesachim 48a:13">Pes. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>ואהדר ליה במ׳ וכ׳</he> and his reply is recorded in another collection.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:8:6">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵇ</cite> top <he>אפיק … מ׳</he> R. Y. produced the M’khilta (v. infra; v. Mekh. Mishp. s. 20, ed. Weiss, p. 107, note 100).—Pl. <cite ref="M01379"><he>מְכִילָאן</he></cite>.

Lev. R. s. 3, beg. רעותיה … בר מ׳ he likes to be called a man mastering many Mekhiltas; Koh. R. to IV, 6 מרי מ׳ (some ed. מיכיילא, מיכלייאן, v. מֵיכְלָא II).—Esp. M’khilta, or M. d’bé R. Yishmael, a Halakhic and Midrashic book on Exodus from ch. XII, to XXXV.
